change_1.description: Added explicit_entities field to IntentResult dataclass. Populated in all IntentClassifier.classify() return paths with only the entities extracted from the current query (never context-inherited).

change_2.description: Line 79: changed _explicit_entities from route_decision.intent.entities (merged) to route_decision.intent.explicit_entities (current-query-only). This ensures update_slots_domain_aware() receives only entities explicitly present in the current query.

why_context_py_unchanged: update_slots_domain_aware() logic is correct when given correct (explicit-only) input. The bug was the wrong dict being supplied to it, not the method itself.
